title_zh: 钱凯港：连接南美与亚洲的新港口
title_en: China's Ports (19/20): Chancay, a New Port Linking South America and Asia
note_en: In 以前，许多货物需要经过美国港口转运，才能到达亚洲市场 "in the past, much cargo had to be transshipped through US ports before it could reach Asian markets," 才能 means "only then could." It marks the second clause as possible only once the first condition is met, where English would use "before" or "only after"; 才 always sits right before the verb, after any subject, never at the start of the clause.
